A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]] was favored on this course, and he would challenge other pilots to race against him here.<ref name="E1R" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.<ref name="E1R" />
